description: Department of Registrar of Companies - Amendment of the Charges Published in the Gaz. Ex. No. 1990/12, Dated 25.10.2016
reasoning: This gazette primarily contains amendments to regulations regarding fees for company registrations and society registrations under existing legislation (Companies Act and Societies Ordinance). It focuses on legal/regulatory framework modifications rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories. The mention of the Minister's name is incidental to the regulatory content, which establishes new fee structures for commercial registrations.
